faqs.answer: The minimum voting age in India is 18 years. You must be at least 18 years old on the qualifying date (1st January of the year of electoral roll revision) to be eligible to vote.

To register as a voter:
1. Visit voters.eci.gov.in
2. Click on 'New Registration'
3. Fill Form 6 with your personal details
4. Upload a passport-sized photo and proof of age/address
5. Submit and note your reference number
6. Your Voter ID will be delivered within 30 days.

Documents required for registration:
• Proof of Age: Birth certificate, Aadhaar, Passport, or School leaving certificate
• Proof of Address: Aadhaar, utility bill, bank statement, or rent agreement
• Passport-sized photograph

On voting day, carry any valid government-issued photo ID.

To find your polling booth:
1. Visit boothapp.eci.gov.in
2. Enter your EPIC number or personal details
3. Your assigned polling booth address will be displayed
4. You can also call the Election Commission helpline: 1950

NRIs (Non-Resident Indians) who are Indian citizens can register as Overseas Voters by filling Form 6A on the ECI portal. You can vote in person at your constituency in India but cannot vote by postal ballot or proxy.
Upcoming elections are announced by the Election Commission of India. Check the official ECI website at eci.gov.in for the latest election schedule and Model Code of Conduct dates.

The Election Commission ensures accessibility for persons with disabilities:
• Ramp access at all polling booths
• Companion allowed for visually impaired or orthopedically challenged voters
• Priority queuing for PwD voters
• Postal ballot facility available for eligible voters
